stations.title: Customer
stations.say: What does a hub gear cost?

stations.title: Parts supplier
stations.text: Answers late, or not at all.

stations.title: Quote screen
stations.text: Shows a price or a plain reason.

captions: The happy path is typed. Now a customer asks what a hub gear costs.
The supplier is offline, and the quote screen just shows undefined.
You type every value you cannot trust, in three tasks.
Now a failed quote comes back as a result the screen can explain.
Same outage, a plain message. Nothing reaches the shop unchecked.
